name: refinely-v3-poc
description: Local POC for a grounded, lean Refinely V3 pipeline.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js --requirement "Allow service planners to submit urgent loaner requests for manager approval while enforcing eligibility and return rules."
